title: Fraction Bistro
summary: A modern Italian-style bistro where learners cut pizza, tarts and focaccia into equal parts to serve exact orders.
mobileSupportNote: Full learning loop verified live at 390x844: single-column layout, tap-to-place is the primary input, partition chips wrap, no horizontal scroll. Drag works but precision is lower on small screens — tap and keyboard paths are the intended inputs there.

cover.alt: Staged serve moment on the cutting table: the Pizza Margherita cut into eight separated slices, five plated, the red SERVITO stamp landed over the station with the 'Servito! 5 of 8 equal parts' feedback strip and kitchen explanation below
